title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Equipment Spec Plate. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Equipment Spec Plate
options.lineage: Stamped capacity plates on strength machines
options.thesis: Home is a load-rating plate for two athletes: perfect days are stamped capacity, spoons are brass proof marks, today is an inspection.
options.viewport: Serial header with countdown, two PFP load-pins on a rack to 31 Dec, then your inspection checklist stacked over the partner's.
options.risk: Reads as an industrial admin panel if the stamps flatten into generic cards.

raised.raise: A failed day traces slack members: missed requirements are the only explanation of the spoon.
PENDING, PERFECT, and FAILED are named plate ratings at full scale, never a colour wash.
Completion is a proof stamp, not a painted hue.
Failed days cancel in place and stay readable; nothing is deleted.
Both athletes lock to one measurement scale so the race is comparable, not decorative.

options.label: Periodized Training Log
options.thesis: Every session is a dated log page: four checks in the margin, notes beside the work, the race as consecutive P marks.
options.viewport: Today's log page fills the screen: day number huge, four requirement rows, partner's page tabbed behind.
options.risk: Also the direction most gym-accountability runs land on: familiar journal, easy to ship as a generic habit tracker.

options.label: Emission Line Rail
options.lineage: Glass spectrogram on a night viewing box
options.thesis: The challenge is one calibrated rail of days; today blooms into a plate, perfect days double, pending days dash.
options.viewport: An off-centre rail of challenge days; today opens as a giant plate above it, partner marks sit on the same continuum.
options.case: Beats the spec plate on race clarity: position is a measured mark. Loses identification: gym partners do not live in a lab spectrogram.
options.risk: Reads as a science instrument and fights prominent stat numerals the product needs.

options.label: Tensegrity Column
options.lineage: Carbon rods and red tension cord
options.thesis: Two athletes as opposing forces: complete days compress, missed work slacks the cord, the column rises only when both hold.
options.viewport: A force diagram of today's four members; slack members name the spoon.
options.case: Loses both axes: partners do not identify with kinetic sculpture, and red-cord drama fights honour-system checkboxes.
options.kept: Trace every failure to its counterforce.

options.label: Cyclorama Dawn
options.lineage: Theatre cyc wall from night to day
options.thesis: The day is a cue: black pending, first light as work lands, full day only when the plate is perfect.
options.viewport: Atmosphere stacked in horizon bands with today's checklist as the actors on stage.
options.case: Loses both: theatre lighting is not this audience, and colour-as-time buries the four scored checks.
options.kept: Named phases at scale, colour never the sole signal.
options.risk: Mood wash over a task surface.

options.label: Cutting Bench
options.lineage: Film work print between bench pins
options.thesis: Each day is a punched frame; grease-cross done, orange flag on today, failed frames hang in the bin.
options.viewport: A perforated strip of days with today flagged; the open frame is the checklist.
options.case: Loses both: film-edit grammar is foreign, and orange occupying a third of the screen fights semantic colour.
options.kept: State is a mark, not a hue.

options.label: Ticket Wallet
options.thesis: The challenge is a coupon book to 31 Dec; each day tears off as validated or VOID.
options.viewport: Today's coupon filling the wallet; remaining days as a stub stack.
options.case: Loses both: travel ephemera is not training, and a sequential wallet cannot stage a two-person race.
options.risk: Airline souvenir instead of a gym journal.

options.label: Botanical Folio
options.lineage: Season plates of one plant at fixed scale
options.thesis: The challenge is five seasonal plates of two athletes, always compared at the same scale.
options.viewport: Side-by-side plates of both people on one baseline, today's work as a caption.
options.case: Loses both: garden folio is the wrong culture, and cream-serif seasonal plates bury the daily loop.
options.kept: Both athletes locked to one measurement scale.
options.risk: Pretty comparison that cannot host a checkbox.

canonCard.label: Premium habit-tracker dashboard
canonCard.thesis: What this category ships: countdown, two progress cards, streak stats, bottom nav, executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Header, race or progress bars, today's two cards, tab bar. The arrangement a visitor expects.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other fitness-accountability app by design.
